"''It sounded like they were under attack.|Stang, and the soldier|}} A [[human]] '''soldier''' served the [[Galactic Empire]] and was present on the [[planet]] [[Mina-Rau]] as part of a [[Krole's contingent|contingent]] aimed to discover undocumented individuals. In [[4 BBY]], the [[soldier]] was [[Death|killed]] after a [[Skirmish on Mina-Rau|skirmish]] ensued following the discovery of several undocumented [[Technician|mechanics]]. {{Char-stub}} ==Behind the scenes== The radio soldier appeared in the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the live-action series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'', first appearing in the series' third episode, "[[Harvest]]," which was released on [[Disney+]] on [[April 22]], [[2025]].{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}} The soldier was portrayed [[Ned Costello]] and listed in the series' credits as "Radio Soldier". ==Appearances== *{{Andor|Harvest}} {{1st}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |ka=რადიოკავშირის უცნობი ჯარისკაცი }} [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with unspecified pronouns]] [[Category:Personnel of the Galactic Empire]]
